alignment_scope: ANAB references TSMM-aligned TIS v0.10 runtime assurance artifacts as named-agent evidence inputs without copying canonical schemas or redefining ANAB control semantics.
tracked_artifact_families: VTI ACL, authorization credential, and status-list reference profiles

changed decision receipt or evidence bundle manifest structure
changed TSMM runtime governance projection semantics
changed AIS-1 profile fields for agent class, parent DID, registry, timestamp service, or assurance container
